plan.notes: Source: Fairfield University 2026-2027 Academic Catalog (current catalog at catalog.fairfield.edu as of 2026-09-30), Computer Science Major (BS) — ABET-accredited track — official 'Plan of Study' grid (typical four-year, full-time plan). Transcription method: catalog plan-of-study PDF text extracted via browser fetch and manually de-interleaved/reconstructed against the requirement footnotes; term credit totals (17/17/17/14-15/16/16/15/15) and degree total (127) match the catalog's published figures exactly. Caveats: (1) The Math Elective in Spring Year 2 is listed as 3-4 credits; 3 credits are used here so the term (14) and degree (127) totals match the published totals. (2) Magis Core tier slots are student-choice slots with placeholder codes; footnote guidance from the catalog is preserved in each choice_note. (3) The four Major Elective slots follow catalog footnote 4: one must come from the Data/AI group (CPSC 4322, CPSC 4350, CPSC 4355, CPSC 4357, CPSC 4360, CPSC 4366, CPSC 4521), one from the Systems group (CPSC 3349, CPSC 4314), and the remaining two are chosen from the department under advisement of the faculty advisor and department chair. (4) Prerequisite chains are not published in the plan-of-study grid, so prereq arrays are left empty per the no-invention rule. (5) Catalog uses 'Object-Orientated' spelling; kept verbatim.
